Question ID: PC_U03_L08_GP_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.PC.TR.12

In Putting It All Together: Trigonometric Functions and Applications, which response best shows mastery of MLA.PC.TR.12

answer.text: Start calculating before identifying the unit synthesis or the required feature

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is a misconception because calculation alone can answer the wrong question. First identify the unit synthesis and the feature being assessed. Review the lesson concept before trying a similar item.

answer.text: Use trigonometric graphs, show the work, and explain the conclusion with evidence

feedback.text: Correct. This is the strongest response because it names the lesson concept, shows the reasoning, and connects the conclusion back to MLA.PC.TR.12.

answer.text: Use a related term from periodic models without checking whether it answers the question

feedback.text: Incorrect. This confuses related vocabulary with the actual target of the question. Use the lesson definition and check that the conclusion matches MLA.PC.TR.12. Review the lesson concept before trying a similar item.

answer.text: Give only a final answer without connecting the result to the lesson standard

feedback.text: Incorrect. This skips the explanation requirement. A mastery response must include reasoning so the Teacher of Record can see how the answer was found. Review the lesson concept before trying a similar item.\
